title: Doctor Strange Keeps Saving Her. Why Does She Still Die?
canon: What If…? S1E4 (2021), alternate animated MCU continuity.

u3.reason: Show the achievement that makes the time-travel paradox possible.
Return to the eye/clock when he chooses to reverse time.

u4.reason: Three changing routes return to the same center.
The teacher links loss, magic and time rather than adding another death montage.

u5.reason: The Ancient One blocks his path and a cracked clock makes the paradox warning physical.
A close-up of forbidden knowledge motivates the next absorption action.

u6.reason: Creatures contract toward his chest; the cloak becomes purple.
The teacher’s branching lines introduce the second self before its action.

u7.reason: The red-cloaked counterpart opposes the purple-cloaked Strange.
The opposing figure contracts into the corrupted one.

u8.reason: Christine steps back from the monstrous form.
The environment visibly breaks after the reversal.
Strange reaches toward the observer when his own magic fails.

u9.reason: The last fragment of reality closes around the two figures.
Christine is absent when the narration reaches his isolation.
The requested CTA begins after the final tragic consequence.
